environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer with default configuration. No WAF rules attached. ALB target group health check on /health. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No CloudFront distribution. Application handles all request processing directly with no middleware rate limiting.

config.rate_limiting: none (app-level lockout only on OTP endpoint, 5 attempts per normalized username)
